title: PromotionGateRun
description: Chapter 5.13's promotion-gate evaluation for a candidate context policy (push, pull, or semantic_retrieval_enabled) against the current certified baseline, over the frozen eval corpus. Durable identity (`run_id`) plus an `idempotency_key` (unique per tenant) so re-submitting the same evaluation request observes the same run instead of recomputing it; `status` is the observable async state. This deployment computes critical_coverage, contradiction_rate (compile-time CONFLICTED rate vs baseline), and token_cost_per_verified_success (compile-token means; a rise FAILs). context_attributed_failure_rate and task_success_on_corpus remain deferred (EDR-0003: they need worker-verification replay per eval case, not a compile() call). `decision` therefore never claims full Chapter 5.13 promotion: it is `INSUFFICIENT_CORPUS`, `FAIL`, or `PARTIAL_PASS_IMPLEMENTED_GATES_ONLY`. Owned by engine.context.
